description_en: Changes the resource group to which an instance belongs
description_zh: 修改实例所在的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun hbr change-resource-group --resource-type vault --resource-id v-0002vido6j5zyh5k0000 --new-resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

vault: backup vault
client: backup client
hanainstance: SAP HANA instance
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：

vault：备份库。
client：备份客户端。
hanainstance：SAP HANA实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. The value of this parameter varies with the resource type. For example, if the ResourceType parameter is set to vault, the ResourceId parameter specifies the ID of the backup vault
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型的ID标识符。例如，当ResourceType=vault时，则ResourceId可以理解为备份库ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group. You can view the available resource groups in the Resource Management console
parameters.help_zh: 新的资源组ID，可在资源组控制台查看可用资源组
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, "successful" is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
